Trace, implement and test: 面试题46. 把数字翻译成字符串

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int translateNum(int num) {
        string s = to_string(num);
        int n = s.size();
        int f[12]{};
        function<int(int)> dfs = [&](int i) -> int {
            if (i >= n - 1) {
                return 1;
            }
            if (f[i]) {
                return f[i];
            }
            int ans = dfs(i + 1);
            if (s[i] == '1' || (s[i] == '2' && s[i + 1] < '6')) {
                ans += dfs(i + 2);
            }
            return f[i] = ans;
        };
        return dfs(0);
    }
};
